### `When`

*interface* · [src/types/persona.ts:25](../../../src/types/persona.ts#L25)

A visibility rule for anything the UI renders. Every key that is set must
pass; an empty rule is universal.

| Member | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `roles?` | `UserRole[]` | Roles the item belongs to. |
| `capsAny?` | `Capability[]` | At least one of these capabilities. |
| `capsAll?` | `Capability[]` | All of these capabilities. |
| `occasions?` | `OccasionId[]` | Customer only: the active occasion is one of these. |
| `forms?` | `BusinessForm[]` | Vendor only: the business form is one of these. |
| `perms?` | `Permission[]` | Platform only: all of these permissions. |
| `permsAny?` | `Permission[]` | Platform only: at least one of these permissions. |
| `teams?` | `PlatformTeam[]` | Platform only: the staff member's team is one of these. |
| `not?` | `When` | Hidden when this nested rule passes. |

## platform.ts

Source: [src/types/platform.ts](../../../src/types/platform.ts)

Shared domain model for the wedding-services orchestration marketplace.
Every role (couple, provider, freelancer, platform team) reads and writes
the same entities; see supabase/migrations for the matching SQL schema.

  Customer ─ Project ─┬─ ProjectEvent (functions)
                      ├─ Requirement ── ServiceBooking ── Assignment ── Freelancer / staff
                      ├─ Quotation (versioned)
                      ├─ PaymentMilestone ── Payment      (customer money)
                      ├─ Payable / RevenueEntry            (payouts, kept separate)
                      ├─ ProjectTask, TimelineEntry, Deliverable
                      └─ Thread ── Message                 (InternalNote is separate)

## toolkit.ts

Source: [src/types/toolkit.ts](../../../src/types/toolkit.ts)

Role toolkits: the smaller planning, business, freelance and operations
tools each app offers on top of the core orchestration loop. They share two
generic collections so a new tool needs no new persisted key:

  ToolEntry   one record in a tool (a gift, an expense, a ticket…)
  ToolState   per-owner settings for a tool (targets, templates, flags)

Mirrored by supabase/migrations/0004_toolkits.sql.
